findings.title: The helmPlayer widening and the snapshot save header miss the snapshot and init sites
findings.claim: Spec L33 widens helmPlayer to 0..n−1 but names only DuelChoice, menuState.ts:89-91 and onlineDuel.ts:33. The snapshot still checks `helm !== 0 && helm !== 1` and types `DuelRoundValues.helmPlayer` as `0 | 1`, and `DuelInit.helmPlayer` is `0 | 1`. In §4.2, `saveDuelSnapshot` and the copy that `validateDuelSnapshot` returns both write `playerCount: DUEL_PLAYERS`, and the spec does not say what they should write instead. The §3 grep patterns would not find the literal `helm !== 0 && helm !== 1` check.
findings.evidence: spec L33, L37-39; src/renderer/src/sim/duel/snapshot.ts:L93 (`helmPlayer: 0 | 1`), :L101 and :L168 (`playerCount: DUEL_PLAYERS` in the header), :L149 (`helm !== 0 && helm !== 1`); src/renderer/src/authority/duelCheckpoint.ts:L21 (`helmPlayer: 0 | 1`)
findings.why: These are small and a round-trip test at n = 3 would catch them. Without them, though, a plan worker could miss the snapshot's helm range, and the header n that save writes has to be stated for the round trip at n = 3 to pass.
findings.fix: In §4.2, add: `saveDuelSnapshot` and `validateDuelSnapshot`'s returned header write `playerCount: d.interior.playerCount` (or the validated n). The helm check becomes 0..n−1, and `DuelRoundValues.helmPlayer` becomes a player id. In §4.1/§4.3, add `DuelInit.helmPlayer` (duelCheckpoint.ts:21) to the 0..3 widening.
